d:
A beautiful melody from the 90s! Enjoy “Chhota Sa Ek Ghar Hoga” from the Bollywood film Muqadama (1996). Sung by Vinod Rathod and Sadhana Sargam, this lovely song features Vinod Khanna and Zeba Bakhtiar. With melodious music by Bappi Lahiri and lyrics by Maya Govind, this song brings back the nostalgic charm of classic Hindi film music.
Movie: Muqadama (1996)
Song: Chhota Sa Ek Ghar Hoga
git: chhota sa ek ghar hoga
Singers: Vinod Rathod, Sadhana Sargam
Music Director: Bappi Lahiri
Lyricist: Maya Govind
Star Cast: Vinod Khanna, Zeba Bakhtiar, Aditya Pancholi, Aasif Sheikh
